headline: China’s CAC reports platform action against AI impersonation of public figures
summary: China’s Cyberspace Administration reported on 6 November that platforms had cleared more than 47,000 items and handled 3,961 accounts in cases involving AI-enabled impersonation of public figures. The notice describes deceptive commerce, fabricated rumors, follower acquisition and synthetic depictions. These are regulator-reported totals without a stated period or denominator; the notice does not establish effectiveness, reduced prevalence, independent verification or a new technical requirement.
